Auth.title: Sign in
Auth.subtitle: Open your hotel workspace and manage the day.
Auth.heroBody: Rooms, bookings and housekeeping in one place.
Auth.usernameInvalid: Use 3–32 English letters or numbers. Dots and dashes are also allowed.
Auth.sessionSaved: You’ll stay signed in on this device until you log out.
Auth.help: Managers create staff accounts in Settings. Contact your manager if you do not have your login details.
Auth.invalidOwner: The email address or password is incorrect. Try again.
Auth.invalidStaff: The username or password is incorrect. Check the details provided by the owner.
Auth.unconfirmed: This account still needs email confirmation.
Auth.hotelCodeHint: Your manager gives you this. It is saved on this device, so you will not need to type it again.
Auth.hotelInvalid: A hotel code is lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
Auth.otherHotel: I work at a different hotel
Auth.resetNeedsEmail: Enter your email address first, then choose “Forgotten your password”.
Auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a link to set a new password has been sent to it. The link lasts an hour, and may land in the spam folder.

Shell.noHotel: This account is not linked to a hotel
Shell.noHotelBody: The account works, but it has not been granted access to a hotel yet. Ask a manager to add it from Settings.
Shell.forbidden: This page is not available to your role ({role}).
Shell.offline: No connection — showing the latest saved copy.
Shell.pending: {count} actions are waiting to be sent.

Dashboard.title: Today overview
Dashboard.roomHint: Select a room to view details and actions.

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.subtitle: Rooms are rows, days are columns. Select a free night to book it, or a stay to see its details.
Calendar.newBookingHere: Book this room from this date

Confirmation.title: Booking confirmation message
Confirmation.copyFailed: Copying failed — select the text and copy it manually
Confirmation.noPhone: This guest has no phone number saved. Add one to the booking first.

Guests.title: Guest records
Guests.subtitle: Hotels in Egypt must record who stayed. Fill this in at check-in while the passport is in hand, and export the period whenever it is asked for.
Guests.exportHint: The file opens straight in Excel, and exports exactly what the current filters show.
Guests.incomplete: {count} guests are missing details in this period.
Guests.search: Search by name, reference or ID number…
Guests.name: Full name as written on the ID
Guests.noHistory: No stays recorded for this guest.

Charges.title: Extras
Charges.voided: Line voided and the bill adjusted
Charges.voidNote: The line is not deleted — it is marked void and drops out of the bill. Taking money off a bill needs the manager password.
Charges.needsNetwork: Extras need a connection — the bill is calculated in the database, not on the phone.
Charges.needQuantity: Quantity must be greater than zero
Charges.settingsNote: These prices fill themselves in when reception picks the item, and can still be changed for one guest.
Charges.noItems: No items yet. Add the first one so reception finds it ready.

Seasons.note: A season overrides the standing price for its dates only. Pricing is night by night, so a stay crossing a season boundary is charged correctly on each side.
Seasons.name: Season name
Seasons.emptyMeansStanding: An empty box means this combination falls back to the standing price during this season.
Seasons.deleted: Season deleted; prices fall back to standing
Seasons.confirmSaveNote: These prices apply to every new booking in this period. Bookings already taken do not change.
Seasons.confirmDeleteNote: The season's prices are removed and the period returns to the standing price. Bookings already taken keep what they were quoted.
Seasons.needDates: Set the season's start and end
Seasons.badDates: The season must end after it starts

Setup.title: Before you go live
Setup.blockingNote: {count} things stand between this and real use.
Setup.advisoryNote: The app is ready to work; these finish it off.
Setup.disappears: This list disappears on its own once every item is done.

rates.title: Real rates
rates.why: Every box is empty, so a new booking prices at zero.

roomTypes.title: Real room types
roomTypes.why: Every room is still “standard room”, and the price depends on the type.

managerPassword.title: Manager password
managerPassword.why: Without it, cancelling, taking a line off a bill and changing rates all pass unchallenged.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp number
whatsapp.why: The booking confirmation is sent from it.

policy.title: Cancellation policy
policy.why: It appears in the confirmation the guest receives.

staff.title: Staff accounts
staff.why: Only the owner's account exists; reception needs its own.

Provisional.title: Provisional bookings
Provisional.leadPending: {count, plural, one {# booking was taken with no connection and has not arrived yet — the room is not held until it does.} other {# bookings were taken with no connection and have not arrived yet — the rooms are not held until they do.}}
Provisional.leadFailed: {count, plural, one {# provisional booking was refused and needs attention.} other {# provisional bookings were refused and need attention.}}
Provisional.leadSent: {count, plural, one {# provisional booking was confirmed.} other {# provisional bookings were confirmed.}}
Provisional.offlineNotice: No connection. This will be recorded provisionally, and the room is not actually held until the connection returns — tell the guest their confirmation follows shortly.
Provisional.recorded: Recorded provisionally for {name}. It will be sent as soon as the connection returns.
Provisional.noPrice: The price is worked out when the booking arrives, because the rates live in the database.
Provisional.availabilityUnknown: These rooms come from the latest copy saved on this device, so availability is not certain.
Provisional.heldByCache: Occupied as of the last update
Provisional.conflictsDraft: Clashes with another provisional booking on this device
Provisional.reasonTaken: The room went to another guest before the connection returned. Call the guest and pick another room.
Provisional.reasonUnauthorised: This account is not allowed to take bookings at this hotel.
Provisional.reasonNoRatePlan: There is no default booking channel in Settings.
Provisional.stay: {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} · {rooms} · {heads, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}
Provisional.noSavedRooms: There is no saved copy of the rooms on this device. Open the app once with a connection, and after that bookings can be recorded offline.
Provisional.duplicates: {count, plural, one {There is one other record on this number} other {There are # other records on this number}}. The one with the longest history was chosen, and new bookings will stop adding more.

Queue.title: An action is stuck
Queue.lead: This action was not accepted, and everything else recorded offline is waiting behind it — the order is kept so a check-out cannot overtake a check-in. Deal with it or delete it so the rest can go through.
Queue.permanent: Trying again will not help — something about the booking changed since this was recorded.
Queue.discardNote: Deleting only removes it from the queue. If it still needs doing, do it from its own screen.

Checkout.earlyBody: The booking runs to {date}. How should the nights they did not stay be billed?
Checkout.earlyNote: Either way the room-nights are recorded as the guest actually slept them, so occupancy and average rate stay honest. Billing the whole booking adds the difference as an early-departure line, which a manager can take off later with their password.

Reset.title: A new password
Reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account, then sign in with it.
Reset.heroBody: One step and you are back in the hotel's screens.
Reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Reset.done: Your password has been changed. Taking you back to sign in so you can use it.
Reset.linkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in screen.
Reset.staffNote: This page is for the owner's account. Staff passwords are reset from Settings → Staff.

Export.note: Opens in Excel as a formatted table: a row per night, with a total at the end.

Backup.title: Backup
Backup.never: No backup has ever been taken. The hotel has no copy right now.
Backup.today: The last backup was taken today.
Backup.lastTaken: {days, plural, one {The last backup was taken yesterday.} other {The last backup was taken # days ago.}}
Backup.what: One file with everything: rooms, types, rates, seasons, guests, bookings, nights, payments, extras, and staff accounts with their roles. It carries no passwords.
Backup.where: Keep the file in two places — your device and your email, say. A file on one device is not a backup.
Backup.notAReplacement: This is a copy you take yourself, so it is only as good as your habit. Automatic daily backups come with upgrading Supabase to Pro, and those are what cover the mistakes you find out about late.
Backup.notBackup: What came back is not a valid backup. Nothing was saved.
Backup.empty: The backup came back with no rooms in it. It was not saved, so you are not left thinking you are covered.
